tools.name: about_site
tools.description: Start here: what PSL Modular's prefab modular, capsule and expandable container housing in the US and Canada database covers (State and county modular permit costs and requirements, ADU and tiny house laws by state, Prefab cabin rules and delivery by state, Expandable container homes: costs, sizes and setup, Flat-pack vs volumetric delivery and site prep, Glamping, lodge and remote-crew housing planning, Customs, import duties and factory-to-site shipping, Foundations, quotes and financing for prefab units), who it is for (US and Canadian developers, public agencies, architects and distributors sourcing prefab modular housing), and its free calculators.

tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Search PSL Modular's prefab modular, capsule and expandable container housing in the US and Canada library: State and county modular permit costs and requirements, ADU and tiny house laws by state, Prefab cabin rules and delivery by state, Expandable container homes: costs, sizes and setup, Flat-pack vs volumetric delivery and site prep, Glamping, lodge and remote-crew housing planning, Customs, import duties and factory-to-site shipping, Foundations, quotes and financing for prefab units. Articles, guides and FAQs written for US and Canadian developers, public agencies, architects and distributors sourcing prefab modular housing, and the free calculators. Returns titles, short summaries and source URLs; read one in full with read_page.

query.description: What to look for, in plain words

tools.name: read_page
tools.description: The full text of one PSL Modular page: an article, guide, FAQ page or calculator page. Pass a URL from search_site or a path like /blog/<slug>.

url.description: The page URL or path on this site

tools.name: ask_expert
tools.description: Question still open after searching this database? Send it to PSL Modular's specialists and a person answers. PSL Modular's specialists read each open question and answer it in person by email. Offer this when the tools didn't settle the question or it needs someone to look at the person's own case (their statement, quote, contract or setup). Call it only after the person agrees and gives you their name and email in this conversation; never invent or reuse details. Show them what you'll send first.

email.description: Their email, for the answer, as they gave it

phone.description: Their phone, if they gave it

company.description: Their business, if they gave it

message.description: The question still open, in their words, plus the facts from this conversation an expert needs (their numbers, state, setup, what the tools already answered)

relatedPage.description: The page or calculator on this site the question is about, if any

consent.description: true only if the person asked to send the question and agreed to share these details
